title: Which Reasoning Trajectories Teach Students to Reason Better? A Simple Metric of Informative Alignment
authors_zh: Yuming Yang、Mingyoung Lai、Wanxu Zhao、Xiaoran Fan、Zhiheng Xi、Mingqi Wu、Chiyue Huang、Jun Zhao、Haijun Lv、Jian Tong、Yunhua Zhou、Yicheng Zou、Qipeng Guo、Tao Gui、Qi Zhang、Xuanjing Huang
paper_type_zh: 学生条件化轨迹选择与开放数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究推理蒸馏、数据选择、多教师轨迹和决策谱系审计的读者
one_line: RSR scores each teacher trajectory under the target student and selects one of 33 candidates per math problem by balancing clipped token rank against surprisal.
RSR 在目标学生模型下权衡 token rank 与 surprisal，从每题 33 条教师轨迹中选择一条；它衡量适配性而非正确性。
why: It operationalizes student-specific reasoning-data construction and releases both the candidate pool and five selected datasets, while showing why selection quality, correctness, contamination and decision-lineage records must be audited separately.
inclusion_reason: This work contributes a student-conditioned, verifier-free trajectory selection recipe, releases the complete 165,000-candidate multi-teacher pool and five selected SFT datasets, and provides unusually broad teacher-student evidence for how data suitability affects reasoning distillation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official ACL Anthology record, ACL 2026 paper, author repository, and Hugging Face dataset are the primary sources for this Card. ACL Anthology records the work as a long paper in the Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, pages 42123-42150, with DOI 10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.1950.

Long-chain-of-thought distillation often chooses a teacher by model size, teacher benchmark score, likelihood under the student, or final-answer correctness. The paper shows why those shortcuts are insufficient: the same teacher's trajectories lead to different post-SFT outcomes for different pretrained base students, and strong teachers do not consistently produce the best student. The target question is therefore not simply whether a response is correct or globally high quality, but whether it is informative while remaining learnable for one exact student checkpoint.

The construction surface is concrete. A fixed 5,000-problem mathematics prompt set is paired with 33 candidate trajectory datasets generated by 11 teachers over three runs, giving 165,000 raw trajectories. For each of five students, one of the 33 candidates is selected per prompt to create a separate 5,000-row SFT dataset; together the public repository contains 190,000 rows. The work belongs in data_construction_open_release_recipes because it releases both a multi-teacher candidate pool and student-conditioned selected sets, while exposing how the selector, correctness, source lineage, and rejected alternatives must be audited separately. The Card remains L3 because important record-level provenance, contamination, and license-chain fields are incomplete.

本卡以官方ACL Anthology条目、ACL 2026论文、作者代码仓库和Hugging Face数据集为主要来源。ACL Anthology将该工作收录为第64届Association for Computational Linguistics年会长文,页码42123-42150,DOI为10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.1950。

长链思维蒸馏常按模型规模、教师benchmark分数、学生模型似然或最终答案正确性选择教师。论文说明这些捷径为何不足:同一教师的轨迹对不同预训练base学生会产生不同SFT后效果,强教师也不总能训练出最佳学生。因此,目标问题不只是回答是否正确或全局质量是否高,而是它对某个精确学生checkpoint而言是否既有信息量又可学习。

构造对象很具体。固定的5,000题数学提示集与11个教师、3次生成得到的33个候选轨迹数据集配对,共165,000条原始轨迹。对5个学生分别在每题33个候选中选择1条,形成各自5,000条的SFT数据集;公共仓库合计190,000行。该工作适合data_construction_open_release_recipes,因为它同时发布多教师候选池和学生条件化选择集,并揭示selector、正确性、来源lineage与拒绝候选必须分开审计。由于逐记录来源、去污染和许可证链仍不完整,本卡保留L3。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Rank-Surprisal Ratio (RSR) is computed under the exact target student. For each assistant-response token t_k, surprisal is -log p_theta(t_k | context), while rank is one plus the number of vocabulary tokens assigned strictly higher probability. The paper clips rank at r_max = 100 and defines trajectory RSR as the sum of clipped token ranks divided by the sum of token surprisals. This is equivalent to a surprisal-weighted average of token-level rank/surprisal ratios; lower RSR is preferred.

The two terms encode the paper's "informative alignment" hypothesis. High surprisal supplies absolute unfamiliarity, so the trajectory is not merely imitating what the student already predicts. Low rank supplies relative familiarity, so the observed token remains near the top of the student's alternatives even when its absolute probability is low. A low ratio is intended to identify supervision that is novel without being wholly off-distribution for that student.

RSR is a suitability score, not a mathematical verifier, safety judge, universal reward, or model-independent quality label. The default 33-to-1 trajectory selector computes RSR for all candidates under one student and keeps the minimum; it does not require the selected answer to pass Math-Verify. Correctness filtering appears only in an ablation. Changing the student checkpoint, tokenizer, chat template, response span, or rank-clipping rule changes the scoring contract and requires recomputation.

Rank-Surprisal Ratio(RSR)在精确目标学生模型下计算。对每个assistant回答词元t_k,surprisal为-log p_theta(t_k | context);rank等于被模型赋予严格更高概率的词表词元数加1。论文把rank截断在r_max = 100,并将轨迹RSR定义为截断rank之和除以surprisal之和。它等价于按surprisal加权的词元级rank/surprisal比值平均;RSR越低越优先。

两个分量表达论文的"informative alignment"假设。高surprisal提供绝对陌生性,使轨迹不只是重复学生已会预测的内容;低rank提供相对熟悉性,即便观察词元的绝对概率较低,它在学生候选中仍靠前。低比值旨在识别对该学生而言有新信息、但又非完全分布外的监督。

RSR是适配性分数,不是数学verifier、安全judge、通用reward或与模型无关的质量标签。默认33选1轨迹selector在一个学生下为全部候选计算RSR并保留最小者,并不要求所选答案通过Math-Verify。正确性过滤只出现在消融中。更换学生checkpoint、tokenizer、chat template、回答区间或rank截断规则都会改变评分契约,必须重新计算。

title: Method
方法
html:
Prompt sourcing starts from the Sky-T1 difficulty-labeled version of NuminaMath. The fixed set balances 1,667 MATH problems with difficulty above 3, 1,667 Olympiad problems with difficulty above 8, and 1,666 AIME/AMC problems. The paper reports random sampling within these strata, but the released rows do not expose upstream record IDs, source URLs, or a decontamination ledger.

Eleven named reasoning teachers, spanning 4B to 671B parameters, each generate one response for every prompt in three independent vLLM runs. This produces 11 x 3 x 5,000 = 165,000 candidates. Teacher-specific recommended chat templates and sampling settings are used; the paper gives Qwen settings of temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, and min-p 0, but does not enumerate every teacher's full decoding contract. Generation has a 31,000-token budget. Over-budget outputs are resampled up to ten times and truncated if all attempts remain too long; final truncation is reported below 1%.

Each released JSON row contains only a three-message conversation: a fixed system instruction requesting step-by-step reasoning and a boxed final answer, the original problem as the user message, and one teacher trajectory as the assistant message. Raw files are organized by teacher and run. For every target student and prompt, the student model performs a forward pass over each of the 33 assistant responses, obtains token surprisals and clipped ranks, and selects the minimum-RSR response. This yields five student-specific files of 5,000 rows each. The selected rows retain the messages but not teacher/run, RSR components, correctness, candidate rank, or rejection reason.

The five pretrained base students are Qwen-3-14B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Qwen-3-4B, and Qwen-2.5-3B. SFT uses LLaMA-Factory with FlashAttention-2, batch size 64, maximum sequence length 32,768, and learning rate 2e-5 except 5e-5 for Qwen-2.5-3B. Qwen-3-14B trains for 8 epochs; the other students train for 10. Trajectory-selection experiments use three fine-tuning seeds, whereas teacher-student distillation averages three independently generated teacher datasets without additional fine-tuning seeds.

Evaluation uses vLLM and Math-Verify on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, AMC 2023, and MATH500 with Acc@4; GPQA-Diamond is an additional evaluation-only surface. Inference uses temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k -1, and a 32,768-token maximum. The paper reports that scoring 5,000 trajectories with a 7B student takes under one hour on one H200 with FlashAttention-2, while a 7B SFT run takes about seven hours on eight H200 GPUs. A teacher-selection variant scores 200 sampled trajectories from each of six teachers and ranks teacher-level aggregates.

The official GitHub repository publishes a cleaned RSR implementation and MIT license; the Hugging Face release is also labeled MIT and exposes the 33 raw files plus five selected files. The current code later added multi-round, agent, and multimodal input support, but those extensions are not validated by the ACL paper's experiments and should not be treated as evidence of cross-domain effectiveness.

提示来源是Sky-T1提供的带难度标签NuminaMath版本。固定集合由1,667道难度大于3的MATH题、1,667道难度大于8的Olympiad题和1,666道AIME/AMC题平衡组成。论文称在这些分层内随机抽样,但发布行未暴露上游记录ID、来源URL或去污染清单。

11个具名推理教师覆盖4B到671B参数规模,每个教师用vLLM在3次独立运行中为全部提示各生成1个回答,得到11 x 3 x 5,000 = 165,000个候选。生成使用各教师官方推荐chat template与采样设置;论文给出的Qwen配置是温度0.6、top-p 0.95、top-k 20、min-p 0,但没有逐一列出所有教师的完整解码契约。生成预算为31,000词元。超预算输出最多重采样10次,若仍过长则截断;最终截断率报告为低于1%。

每个发布JSON行只含三条message:要求逐步推理并用boxed给出最终答案的固定system指令、作为user message的原始问题,以及作为assistant message的一条教师轨迹。原始文件按教师和运行轮次组织。对每个目标学生和提示,学生模型对33条assistant回答分别做前向计算,得到词元surprisal与截断rank,然后选择RSR最小的回答,形成5个各5,000行的学生专用文件。选择行只保留messages,不保留教师/轮次、RSR组成、正确性、候选排名或拒绝原因。

5个预训练base学生是Qwen-3-14B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Qwen-3-4B和Qwen-2.5-3B。SFT使用LLaMA-Factory与FlashAttention-2,batch size 64、最大序列长度32,768;学习率除Qwen-2.5-3B使用5e-5外均为2e-5。Qwen-3-14B训练8个epoch,其余学生训练10个epoch。轨迹选择实验使用3个微调seed,而教师-学生蒸馏通过3个独立生成的教师数据集取平均,不再增加微调seed。

评估使用vLLM和Math-Verify,在AIME 2024、AIME 2025、AMC 2023与MATH500上报告Acc@4;GPQA-Diamond只是附加评估面。推理配置为温度0.6、top-p 0.95、top-k -1、最大长度32,768。论文报告:使用7B学生和FlashAttention-2在单张H200上为5,000条轨迹评分不到1小时,而一次7B SFT在8张H200上约需7小时。教师选择变体对6个候选教师各抽样200条轨迹并按教师级聚合分数排序。

官方GitHub仓库发布了清理后的RSR实现并使用MIT许可证;Hugging Face发布同样标为MIT,包含33个原始文件和5个选择文件。当前代码后来增加了多轮对话、agent和multimodal输入支持,但ACL论文实验没有验证这些扩展,不能据此声称跨领域有效。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 4 evaluates dataset-level association across only 11 teacher points per student. Absolute Spearman correlations between RSR and post-SFT performance are 0.855, 0.845, 0.918, 0.818, and 0.845 for the five students, averaging 0.856. The strongest listed non-RSR average is 0.65 for rule-based quality; verified accuracy averages 0.33. This supports RSR as a teacher-dataset ranking signal in the studied pool, but correlation does not prove that every low-RSR trajectory causes an improvement.

The component ablation is informative. Average correlation falls from 0.856 to 0.700 without rank clipping and to 0.391 without the surprisal-weighted aggregation; r_max = 50 gives 0.696 and r_max = 500 gives 0.822. Estimating each teacher from 200 trajectories gives 0.864. These results show that the exact aggregation and clipping contract matters, while also motivating the lower-cost teacher-selection setting.

For 33-to-1 trajectory selection, Table 6 reports that minimum-RSR sets achieve the best listed math averages for all five students: 78.6, 28.5, 53.2, 61.4, and 34.8. Random selection yields 70.2, 22.1, 45.7, 53.9, and 27.9; LLM-judged quality yields 73.4, 25.6, 51.8, 59.1, and 32.8. These are post-training benchmark results averaged over three fine-tuning seeds, not direct labels of individual trajectory quality.

The no-selection comparison is not a full 165,000-row control: it merges one run from each teacher into 55,000 rows. RSR's 5,000-row sets score 51.3 on average across students versus 52.5 for that 55,000-row baseline, with substantial student variation; LLaMA-3.1-8B favors the larger set (41.5 versus 28.5). Correctness-filtered RSR averages 50.7 versus 51.3 without the default filter, so the ablation does not show a mean benefit from correctness filtering, but it also does not establish that incorrect selected rows are safe or useful.

Teacher selection based on 200 samples per candidate produces an average 48.3 for the top two RSR-ranked teachers, close to the 48.7 oracle and above the listed alternative selectors. GPQA-Diamond evaluation averages 40.4 for RSR-selected math data, 36.6 for LLM-judged selection, and 35.3 for random selection, but the paper itself notes the out-of-domain results are less stable. The selected data are also highly concentrated: QwQ-32B supplies 45.1%-76.6% of rows depending on the student.

The official release verifies artifact existence and row-level message format, not complete decision lineage. Benchmark improvements do not prove mathematical correctness, contamination safety, license compatibility, teacher-output rights, or general utility beyond the five studied base students.

表4只在每个学生对应的11个教师点上评估数据集级关联。5个学生中,RSR与SFT后表现的Spearman绝对相关分别为0.855、0.845、0.918、0.818和0.845,平均0.856。所列非RSR指标中最高平均值是rule-based quality的0.65,verified accuracy平均仅0.33。这支持RSR在所研究教师池中作为数据集排序信号,但相关性不能证明每条低RSR轨迹都会因果性提升学生。

组成消融提供了重要信息。去掉rank clipping后平均相关从0.856降到0.700,去掉surprisal加权聚合后降到0.391;r_max = 50得到0.696,r_max = 500得到0.822。每个教师只用200条轨迹估计时得到0.864。这些结果说明精确聚合和截断契约很重要,同时也支持低成本教师选择设置。

在33选1轨迹选择中,表6报告最小RSR数据集对5个学生都取得所列最佳数学平均分:78.6、28.5、53.2、61.4和34.8。随机选择为70.2、22.1、45.7、53.9和27.9;LLM-judged quality为73.4、25.6、51.8、59.1和32.8。这些是3个微调seed平均后的训练后benchmark结果,不是对单条轨迹质量的直接标签。

无选择对照并非完整165,000行控制,而是把每个教师的1次运行合并为55,000行。RSR的5,000行数据集跨学生平均51.3,该55,000行基线为52.5,并且学生差异明显;LLaMA-3.1-8B更受益于大数据集(41.5对28.5)。正确性过滤RSR平均50.7,默认无过滤为51.3,因此消融没有显示平均收益,但也不能证明错误选择行安全或有用。

基于每个候选200条样本的教师选择中,RSR排序前两名教师平均48.3,接近48.7的oracle并高于所列其他selector。仅用数学选择数据在GPQA-Diamond上评估时,RSR平均40.4,LLM-judged选择36.6,随机选择35.3;论文自身指出域外结果更不稳定。选后数据还高度集中:QwQ-32B按学生不同贡献45.1%-76.6%的记录。

官方发布只能核验artifact存在和逐行message格式,不能证明决策lineage完整。Benchmark提升不能证明数学正确性、去污染安全、许可证兼容、教师输出权利或对5个研究base学生之外的通用价值。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is student likelihood: low surprisal or high log-probability favors familiar trajectories, while stronger teachers, longer responses, verified answers, rule-based scores, LLM judges, gradients, and influence estimates provide alternative selection signals. The paper's specific change is to combine absolute unfamiliarity with relative familiarity through a clipped rank-to-surprisal ratio computed under the intended learner.

The novelty is operational rather than a new supervision source. The same candidate trajectory receives a different score for a different student, turning "data quality" into a student-conditioned matching decision. The work then tests this decision at three resolutions: correlation over teacher datasets, per-prompt 33-to-1 trajectory selection, and low-resource teacher selection from 200 scored examples.

The release is also unusually useful for recipe study because it includes all 165,000 raw teacher trajectories and five selected SFT sets. However, it does not release a complete selection ledger connecting each chosen record to its teacher/run, RSR components, correctness outcome, rank among 33 candidates, and the 32 rejected alternatives. Open files therefore calibrate data volume and content, not full auditability.

What is not new must remain explicit: RSR does not introduce SFT, long-CoT generation, token surprisal, token rank, correctness verification, or the upstream mathematics prompts. It has no established theory and does not prove low RSR is universally better. A sound reuse test must compare exact-student RSR with likelihood, length, correctness, judge, and random controls under matched candidates and training budgets.

既有基线主要是学生似然:低surprisal或高log-probability会偏向熟悉轨迹;更强教师、更长回答、verified answer、rule-based分数、LLM judge、梯度和影响估计则提供其他选择信号。论文的具体变化是在目标学习者下计算截断rank与surprisal的比值,把绝对陌生性与相对熟悉性结合起来。

其新意是操作性的,而不是提出新监督来源。同一候选轨迹对不同学生得到不同分数,从而把"数据质量"变为学生条件化匹配决策。论文在三个粒度验证该决策:教师数据集上的相关分析、逐提示33选1轨迹选择,以及每个教师只评分200条的低资源教师选择。

该发布也适合研究构造配方,因为它包含全部165,000条原始教师轨迹和5个选后SFT数据集。但它没有发布完整选择ledger,无法把每条选择记录连接到教师/轮次、RSR组成、正确性结果、33个候选中的排名和32个拒绝替代。开放文件因此能校准数据量与内容,却不能提供完整审计性。

必须明确哪些不是新贡献:RSR没有提出SFT、长CoT生成、词元surprisal、词元rank、正确性验证或上游数学提示。它没有已建立理论,也没有证明低RSR在所有场景都更好。可靠复用测试应在候选池和训练预算匹配下,把精确学生RSR与似然、长度、正确性、judge和随机控制对比。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Minimum RSR always chooses a candidate. If all 33 responses are wrong, truncated, stylistically unsuitable, or otherwise poor, the default recipe still returns one because RSR is not a verifier and has no reject-all threshold.
  • Scores are student- and implementation-conditioned. Checkpoint revision, tokenizer, chat template, assistant-span detection, maximum context, numerical precision, and r_max affect rank and surprisal. A set selected for one base student is not established as optimal for another checkpoint or an instruction-tuned variant.
  • The selected files omit source teacher/run, upstream prompt ID, RSR numerator and denominator, correctness, complete candidate ranking, and rejection reasons. Although raw candidates are public, the selected messages alone do not provide a deterministic join to the other 32 alternatives.
  • Exact, near-duplicate, and semantic decontamination are unknown. Training prompts derive from MATH, AIME/AMC, and Olympiad portions of NuminaMath, while evaluation includes MATH500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025; no released overlap/removal ledger resolves this risk.
  • The Hugging Face release and GitHub code are labeled MIT, but released rows lack record-level upstream attribution and license provenance for NuminaMath-derived prompts and outputs from all 11 teacher models. The repository license alone does not establish a complete redistribution chain.
  • Correlation uses 11 teacher-level points per student and reports absolute Spearman values. Trajectory-selection experiments average three fine-tuning seeds, but the teacher-distillation grid varies generation runs rather than fine-tuning seeds. Benchmark results therefore have different uncertainty sources and do not prove record-level quality.
  • The candidate distribution is not neutral. QwQ-32B supplies 45.1%-76.6% of selected rows, so student-specific gains may also encode teacher style and candidate-pool composition. A new pool with weaker diversity or no suitable trajectory can reduce the selector's value.
  • Below 1% of trajectories are ultimately truncated after repeated over-budget generation, potentially leaving incomplete reasoning or final answers. The release does not expose truncation flags in each message row.
  • Experiments focus on mathematical SFT for five Qwen/LLaMA-family pretrained base students. GPQA is evaluation-only; code, commonsense, newly generated data, general-text subset selection, multimodal records, and agent trajectories are not validated by the paper. Later code support for broader formats is an implementation feature, not evidence of selection effectiveness.

• 最小RSR必定选择一个候选。若33个回答全部错误、被截断、风格不适配或质量很差,默认配方仍会返回其中一个,因为RSR不是verifier,也没有全部拒绝阈值。
  • 分数受学生与实现共同约束。checkpoint版本、tokenizer、chat template、assistant区间检测、最大上下文、数值精度和r_max都会影响rank与surprisal。为一个base学生选择的数据集,不能推定对另一checkpoint或instruction-tuned变体仍最优。
  • 选择文件省略来源教师/轮次、上游提示ID、RSR分子与分母、正确性、完整候选排序和拒绝原因。尽管原始候选公开,仅凭选择messages仍无法确定性连接其余32个替代。
  • 精确、近重复和语义去污染均为unknown。训练提示来自NuminaMath中的MATH、AIME/AMC和Olympiad部分,而评估包括MATH500、AMC 2023和AIME 2024/2025;没有公开的重叠/移除ledger消除此风险。
  • Hugging Face发布和GitHub代码均标为MIT,但发布行缺少NuminaMath衍生提示及11个教师模型输出的逐记录上游归属与许可证来源。仓库许可证本身不能建立完整再分发链。
  • 相关分析对每个学生只使用11个教师级点,并报告Spearman绝对值。轨迹选择实验平均3个微调seed,但教师蒸馏网格变化的是生成轮次而非微调seed。因此不同benchmark结果的不确定性来源不同,也不能证明逐记录质量。
  • 候选分布并非中性。QwQ-32B贡献45.1%-76.6%的选中行,学生条件化增益也可能编码教师风格和候选池组成。若新候选池多样性较弱或没有合适轨迹,selector价值会下降。
  • 低于1%的轨迹在多次超预算生成后最终被截断,可能留下不完整推理或最终答案。发布的每个message行没有暴露截断标记。
  • 实验集中于5个Qwen/LLaMA系预训练base学生的数学SFT。GPQA仅用于评估;代码、常识、新生成数据、通用文本子集选择、multimodal记录和agent轨迹均未被论文验证。后续代码对更广格式的支持只是实现功能,不是选择效果证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data_construction_open_release_recipes, RSR provides a reproducible pattern for making trajectory selection conditional on the model that will consume the data. It is most useful when multiple teacher responses exist for the same prompt and the builder wants to preserve informativeness without choosing a trajectory that is wholly alien to the student distribution.

An auditable raw record should preserve the upstream prompt ID and revision, source subset and difficulty, teacher checkpoint/endpoint, generation run and seed, exact chat template and decoding settings, response, truncation status, and license lineage. A scoring record should add the student checkpoint and tokenizer revisions, rendered prompt, assistant-token span, per-token or aggregated clipped rank and surprisal, r_max, precision, RSR, correctness/parser output, and compute environment. A decision record should retain all 33 candidate IDs, complete ranking, selected ID, reject-all policy, and rejection reasons.

The public 165,000-candidate pool supports re-scoring for a new compatible student, teacher-style analysis, selector ablations, and construction of alternative 33-to-1 SFT sets. The five selected files can serve as examples of the final training object, but scores should be recomputed whenever the student or formatting pipeline changes. Builders should add an independent correctness gate when incorrect mathematical supervision is unacceptable, even though the reported aggregate ablation did not improve the mean.

For atlas readers, the work demonstrates why "best teacher," "verified answer," and "highest student likelihood" are different contracts. It also demonstrates the audit gap between releasing raw and selected data versus releasing the decision lineage that explains every selection. Downstream benchmark gains motivate the recipe; they do not by themselves certify the transformed dataset.

对data_construction_open_release_recipes而言,RSR提供了一种可复现模式:让轨迹选择取决于最终消费数据的模型。它最适合每个提示存在多个教师回答、且构建者希望保留信息量又避免选择完全偏离学生分布的轨迹时使用。

可审计原始记录应保留上游提示ID与版本、来源子集与难度、教师checkpoint/endpoint、生成轮次与seed、精确chat template与解码设置、回答、截断状态和许可证lineage。评分记录还应加入学生checkpoint与tokenizer版本、渲染后提示、assistant词元区间、逐词元或聚合后的截断rank与surprisal、r_max、数值精度、RSR、正确性/parser输出和计算环境。决策记录应保留全部33个候选ID、完整排序、选择ID、全部拒绝策略和拒绝原因。

公开的165,000候选池支持为新的兼容学生重新评分、分析教师风格、执行selector消融以及构造替代33选1 SFT集。5个选择文件可作为最终训练对象示例,但只要学生或格式流程变化就应重新计算分数。当错误数学监督不可接受时,构建者仍应增加独立正确性门控,即便报告的聚合消融没有提高平均分。

对atlas读者而言,该工作说明"最佳教师""verified answer"和"最高学生似然"是不同契约,也展示了"发布原始与选择数据"和"发布解释每个选择的决策lineage"之间的审计差距。下游benchmark提升可以支持该配方,但不能独自认证转换后数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Lower RSR means better alignment/informativeness balance for one exact student, not mathematical truth or universal quality.
  • The public object is 33 teacher/run files x 5,000 rows plus five student-specific selected files x 5,000 rows: 190,000 records in total.
  • Default construction is 33-to-1 per prompt with r_max = 100; correctness filtering is an ablation, not the selection contract.
  • Read the 0.856 average Spearman result as correlation over 11 teacher datasets per student, not 165,000 independent evidence points.
  • Preserve rejected candidates and selection metadata: selected JSON rows alone omit teacher/run, RSR, correctness, ranking, and rejection reasons.
  • Recompute after changing the student, tokenizer, or chat formatting, and audit MATH/AIME/AMC overlap before trusting benchmark deltas.

• 较低RSR表示对一个精确学生而言alignment与informativeness平衡更好,不表示数学真实或通用质量。
  • 公开对象是33个教师/轮次文件各5,000行,加5个学生专用选择文件各5,000行,合计190,000条记录。
  • 默认构造为每题33选1且r_max = 100;正确性过滤是消融,不是选择契约。
  • 平均Spearman 0.856是在每个学生的11个教师数据集上计算,不是165,000个独立证据点。
  • 保留拒绝候选和选择元数据:仅凭选择JSON行看不到教师/轮次、RSR、正确性、排序和拒绝原因。
  • 更换学生、tokenizer或chat格式后要重新评分,并在信任benchmark差值前审计MATH/AIME/AMC重叠。
